name: Richard H. Agins
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Chandler, Arizona
side_practice_areas: Estate Planning & Probate, Business & Corporate, Bankruptcy
about: Richard H. Agins attended law school and graduated from Pace University Law School in 2003. Richard Agins began practicing law in 2003.
Richard Agins is an attorney at Agins Law Firm, PLC, helping people with Estate Planning & Probate issues. Agins Law Firm, PLC has an office in Chandler, Arizona, serving the local community.

Richard Agins was selected to Rising Stars for 2010 - 2011, 2013. Rising Stars is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
